Questions, answered.

What does a landscape architecture and design studio do?

We plan, design, build and maintain landscapes for residential, corporate and hospitality spaces, using plants grown in our own nurseries.

Do you rent plants for offices and events?

Yes. Events rental runs for 1 to 2 days. Corporate rental runs for 2 to 3 years, combined with AMC.

What is a plant AMC?

An Annual Maintenance Contract covers servicing, plant health and replacements for new and existing landscapes. We serve 175+ clients.

Which cities do you serve?

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune.

Do you build vertical gardens?

Yes, interior and exterior, including offices such as ABB and WSP.

About Star Gardens

Farmers, growers, horticulturists.

Star Gardens hails from a family of farmers and was established in 2009. We grow our own plants and keep ready stock at any given time, so a design never waits on a supplier.

Today the studio designs and builds landscapes and looks after them for 175+ clients.

Projects

Blogs and guides

Office plants: rent or buy?

Rental plus AMC against buying outright.

Read more

Renting keeps plants fresh and moves the cost to operating spend, which suits growing offices and events. Buying suits stable spaces with a long horizon, as long as someone maintains the plants. Our corporate rental runs 2 to 3 years with AMC included.

Planning a vertical garden

What to decide before you start.

Read more

Settle light, watering and wall structure first, then choose plants to suit them. Plan maintenance access from day one. Interior and exterior walls need different plant palettes.

What a plant AMC covers

Servicing, health and replacements.

Read more

An AMC covers regular servicing, plant health care and replacements, for landscapes we built and ones we did not.
